behavior_summary: 27 typed domain namespaces with @ApiInterface/@EncodableClass contracts, generated *Implem stubs, and named Fiz* exceptions — the architectural template for Family OS modules.
description: Typed Domain SDK: 27 namespaces under com.jeronimo.fiz.api (account:52 … sync:1 files), RPC interfaces with explicit wire method names, encodable beans, enums, and named domain exceptions. Implementations generated (Generator.java, *Implem in codec/impl/streamable).
name: Typed Domain SDK Foundation (27 Namespaces)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Mirror the contract-first pattern in Family OS: per-module I*Api interfaces + encodable DTOs + named exceptions; do not port the codec verbatim.

behavior_summary: Every domain entity carries a composite typed identity enabling uniform sync, authz scoping (IApiClientRequest.setScope) and cache keying.
description: MetaId{type, ownerId, objectId, metaContent, external} + MetaIdTypeEnum (~90 values: account, family, event, task, invitation, calendar, budget, dish, recipe, alexaCredential…) with strict constructor validation and check()/fromOrdinal().
name: MetaId Unified Identity System (~90 Types)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Adopt the composite-identity concept (type+owner+object) for Family OS entities; reimplement in Dart/Kotlin.

behavior_summary: Wire format is declared, not implied: field names, nullability, UTF-8 length caps and server-read-only flags live in annotations consumed by the codec generator.
description: @Encodable(value, isNullable, maxUTF8length, serverinput, isExtends, isInlined) on setters; @EncodableClass(id) on contracts; e.g. IFamilyMember.adminRight → wire name 'right', IInvitation.firstname capped at 45 UTF-8 chars.
name: @Encodable Codec Contract System

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Adopt explicit wire-name mapping in Family OS DTOs to decouple renames from protocol.

behavior_summary: One request abstraction for all API calls: sync/async execution, transactional flag, MetaId scope for server-side authorization, stub acquisition, call prefix.
description: IApiClientRequest: doRequest(), doRequestAsync()→IListenableFuture<Reader>, setTransactional(boolean), setScope(MetaId), getCallPrefix(), getStub(Class<T>), getResponseMap(). Custom JSON codec stack (IJsonCodecFormat, ByteBufferJsonCodecFormat) over plain HTTP.
name: IApiClientRequest Transport Abstraction

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Use as interface reference for Family OS API client; implement over modern HTTP stack.

behavior_summary: Each logical permission bundles its Android permissions with the exact icon/title/description the rationale dialog shows; SDK>=33 media/audio branching computed in the enum constructor.
description: FWPermission enum, 11 values: 6 location variants, CALENDAR, CONTACT, STORAGE, RECORD_AUDIO, NOTIFICATIONS. Each = (icon, title, explicitText, androidPermissions[]).
name: FWPermission OS-Permission UX Bundles (11)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Copy verbatim: com/familywall/app/permissions/FWPermission.java → Family OS permission bundles module.

behavior_summary: Single choke point for runtime permission UX: AND-checks the bundle (with the FINE_LOCATION skip quirk), routes first-time→direct request, rationale→dialog, seen-and-denied→settings redirect.
description: PermissionManager (smali-read): checkPermission, askPermissionAndroid 3-branch flow, shouldShowRationale (alwaysRequestRationalePermissions list first), shouldRedirectToSettings, SharedPreferences 'PermissionManager.FWPERMISSION' seen-state keyed by enum name; PermissionRationaleDialog renders from the enum.
name: PermissionManager Enforcement Engine

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Copy the state machine; review the ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION skip before adopting.

behavior_summary: Circle admin rights are an enum on the wire; the admin RPC surface (change/getright/list/remove/wipefamily) is enforced server-side and surfaces as named exceptions — the client never decides rights.
description: FamilyAdminRightEnum{None, Admin, SuperAdmin, SubAccount} + isAdmin(); IAdminApi (@ApiInterface name='admin') with change/getright/list/remove/wipefamily/delete2; FizNotEnougthRightException / FizApiModelRightException; AdminRightBean{administrators[], others[]}.
name: Server-Side Circle Rights (FamilyAdminRightEnum + IAdminApi)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Adopt as the core of the Family OS flexible-roles engine: rights enum + admin RPC + server-side enforcement + named denial exceptions.

behavior_summary: Every domain object can carry its own canDelete/canUpdate verdicts computed server-side; 'denied' is never serialized — only positive grants travel.
description: FizRightBean{canDelete, canUpdate}: setters coerce FALSE→null before encoding (@Encodable isNullable). Client consumes verdicts without deciding them.
name: FizRightBean Per-Object Rights Model

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Copy the FALSE→null coercion idiom into Family OS DTOs for per-object action gating.

behavior_summary: Members carry wire-mapped admin rights and display roles; circles are UI snapshots for multi-family switching.
description: IFamilyMember (id=-1192827385): adminRight→'right', familyRole→'role', customFamilyRole→'customRole', familyId MetaId, isFirstFamily, joinDate/lastLoginDate. IExtendedFamilyMember adds currentLocation, isLoggedAccount, isPanicButtonActivated, isFWPremiumMemberSubscriber. CircleInfo{familyId, isPremium, isFirstFamily, memberCount, creationDate, role}.
name: Family Data Model (IFamilyMember/IExtendedFamilyMember/CircleInfo)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Use as field-level reference for Family OS member/circle entities.

behavior_summary: Invites grant admin rights at creation, travel via token links, and report delivery through a dedicated error taxonomy for email/SMS.
description: IInvitation (id=860376258): invitationId, familyId, accountId, ownerId, firstname (45 UTF-8), familyRole/customRole, adminRights (non-null 'right'), token/tokenId, editable, isReminderSet. InvitationStatusEnum: PENDING, PENDING_EMAIL_DELIVERED, ERR_EMAIL_*, ERR_SMS_INVALID_ADDRESS, OPEN_URL.
name: Invitation State Machine (IInvitation + Statuses)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Adopt the invite-with-rights + delivery-status-taxonomy pattern for Family OS onboarding.

behavior_summary: Complete recurrence model: enum + interval + end conditions + raw RRULE + exception dates + server-side deleted occurrences, with normalization and tolerant equality.
description: RecurrencyDescriptor: RecurrencyEnum (NONE/DAILY/WEEKLY/BIWEEKLY/MONTHLY/SEMI_MONTHLY/YEARLY/DAYWEEK), interval, endDate/endOccurence, rrule, exdate/rdate, byDay/byMonthDay, recurrencyDeletedOccurence (serverinput=false); repairRecurrency(); isTheSame() with 23h tolerance.
name: RecurrencyDescriptor Recurrence Engine

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Copy verbatim: com/jeronimo/fiz/api/event/RecurrencyDescriptor.java → Family OS calendar module.

behavior_summary: Calendar schema covers reminders (type/unit/value + local alarmId), attendees (response/status), event types (incl. TASK and birthdays), ICS import and external calendar subscriptions.
description: ReminderBean/IReminder{reminderType, reminderUnit, reminderValue, alarmId, localId}; AttendeeBean{accountId, attendeeResponse, attendeeStatus}; EventTypeEnum{UNKNOWN, BIRTHDAY, BIRTHDAY_ACCOUNT, EXTERNAL, TASK, SPECIAL_DAYS, ANNIVERSARY, BIRTHDAY_CUSTOM}; IcalImportResultBean; extCalendarGoogle/extCalendarOutlook MetaId types; ReminderJobIntentService + exact-alarm permissions.
name: Reminder/Attendee/Calendar Schema Set

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Adopt field sets for Family OS calendar; TASK-as-event-type unifies tasks and events.

behavior_summary: Tasks are lists with types (todos/shopping), assignees, categories, sorting, and a categorized text-suggestion database synced separately.
description: TaskSuggestionBean(id=8012){value, categoryId, alternates[]} + getCategoryMetaId; TaskListTypeEnum{TODOS, SHOPPING_LIST, OTHER}; AssigneeBean{accountId}; CategoryDescriptor; TaskListSettingsBean; TaskSuggestionSyncBean.
name: Task & List Domain (TaskSuggestionBean, TaskListTypeEnum)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Use as schema reference for Family OS tasks/lists; suggestions DB is a seed for AI task suggestions.

behavior_summary: Offline-first write path: local SQLite with writeback state columns, an ordered retryable jobs queue with cross-job dependency resolution, exposed via ContentProvider.
description: familywall_provider.db v6: data (BLOB + UNIQUE(family_id,object_type,object_id,list_id) REPLACE), data_list, jobs (clientModifId UNIQUE, job BLOB, retry_nb, status, next_id/previous_id chain), jobsdepends (clientModifId→usingClientModifId + valueFromServer). FamilyProvider: 8 URI routes, authority com.familywall.provider.
name: WriteBack Sync Engine (4 SQLite Tables + Jobs Queue)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Copy the 4-table SQL schema verbatim (see T3 §C.1); reimplement the queue runner for Family OS offline-first sync.

behavior_summary: Declarative per-type caching policy: what is cached, listed, family-scoped, and syncable is data, not code.
description: CacheObjectType ~50 entries × (MetaIdTypeEnum, isFamilyRelated, isList, isGenericMetaApi, isSyncable); isSingleton()=!isList. WriteBackCacheStateEnum{NO_OP, PENDING_CREATE, PENDING_UPDATE, PENDING_DELETE}.
name: CacheObjectType Capability Matrix (~50 Types)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Reimplement as Family OS cache-policy matrix; keep the 5-flag vocabulary.

behavior_summary: Server pushes invalidations; clients refetch. PushMessageBean decoded via the codec engine; notification rendering via PushBackgroundService.
description: FcmListenerService.onMessageReceived → ICodecEngine.decode → PushMessageBean{accountId, familyId, metaId, messageType, extraJson…} → handleRegularMessage → PushBackgroundService.onPushWakeUpFetchAndShowNotification. CacheInvalidatedMessageBean{classname, ownerId}. PushTypeEnum with iOS flags.
name: FCM Cache-Invalidation Push Plane

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Adopt invalidate-not-deliver as the Family OS push discipline.

behavior_summary: Family contacts and calendars surface inside Android's native apps via real SyncAdapters bound to the Family OS account.
description: contact_syncadapter + calendar_syncadapter XML resources + SyncAdapter services in manifest; AccountManager account (Authenticator/AuthenticationService) anchors them.
name: OS Sync Adapters (Contacts + Calendar)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Study later for deep OS integration phase; not needed for MVP.

behavior_summary: Circle admins provision a Family Email address; forwarded emails/PDFs are converted to calendar events by server-side AI; clients poll/manage via aiinboxcheck/aiinboxsave and iaimportemail.
description: IWebApi.importemail (@ApiMethod 'iaimportemail': email/from/ical → IcalImportResultBean); ISettingsApi.aiinboxcheck/aiinboxsave (smali); AiInboxResponseBean{available, current, alternative, domain}; Compose UI (aiimport smali); 55 calendar_email_import_* strings; admin-gated activation.
name: AI Email-to-Event Import (Family Email / iaimportemail)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Use as the reference design for the Family OS father-agent's email→event skill: admin-gated inbox + server extraction + IcalImportResultBean contract.

behavior_summary: Login surfaces as a first-class Android account, enabling system integrations (SyncAdapters) and authenticator-based flows.
description: Authenticator extends AbstractAccountAuthenticator (addAccount → FirstUseActivity); AuthenticationService binds it; AUTHENTICATE_ACCOUNTS permission.
name: AccountManager Authentication Integration

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: Adopt for Family OS if OS-level account integration is desired; otherwise conceptual reference.

behavior_summary: Documented only to forbid reuse: secret-code debug receiver, exported location services/receivers, ad/analytics keys.
description: DebugReceiver on android_secret_code://4242; exported GeotrackingRequestForegroundService + geofence/geotracking receivers; AdMob/AppsFlyer keys. None of these are reused.
name: Security Anti-Patterns Catalog (Explicitly Rejected)

reusability_assessment.actionable_path: None — do not reuse.
